# PokeNexus — GitHub Copilot

Follow `AGENTS.md` and `docs/agents/copilot-assistant.md`.

Copilot is a local pair programmer, not an architectural authority.

- Stay inside the active task.
- Do not redesign architecture.
- Do not introduce dependencies unless explicitly required.
- Do not change DB strategy, realtime topology, public protocol or game rules.
- Do not modify unrelated files.
- Prefer existing patterns.
- Update tests when behavior changes.
- Do not generate changelogs, progress reports, completion-summary files or AI attribution.
- Never claim validation passed unless it ran.
